related.title: Apollo 載人月球工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學帶深門檻為 0.15，連續譜改版會翻轉分類，應標示不穩健。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A teaching band-depth threshold of 0.15 is crossed by continuum revision, so label the classification unstable. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 以火箭方程比較攜帶無用結構質量對速度增量的影響。
related.differenceEn: Use the rocket equation to compare the velocity penalty of carrying inactive structural mass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成帶中心反射率 0.16，兩側內插連續譜 0.20。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：D=1−0.16/0.20。 結果約 0.2 fraction。帶深 D=1−R帶/R連續譜；須先校正熱輻射與觀測幾何，連續譜不能為零。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學有效排氣速度 3000 m/s，燃燒前質量 10000 kg，後 6000 kg。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Δv=3000 ln(10000/6000)。 結果約 1532.48 m/s。理想 Δv=ve ln(m0/mf)，只計質量比；實際還有重力、操控與軌道損失。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic band-center reflectance is 0.16 and interpolated continuum 0.20. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: D=1−0.16/0.20. Result ≈ 0.2 fraction. Band depth D=1−Rband/Rcontinuum requires thermal and geometric correction and a nonzero continuum.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching effective exhaust speed 3000 m/s, initial mass 10000 kg and final mass 6000 kg. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Δv=3000 ln(10000/6000). Result ≈ 1532.48 m/s. Ideal Δv=ve ln(m0/mf) captures mass ratio only; real flight includes gravity, steering and trajectory losses.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Cygnus 太空站補給船
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學帶深門檻為 0.15，連續譜改版會翻轉分類，應標示不穩健。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A teaching band-depth threshold of 0.15 is crossed by continuum revision, so label the classification unstable. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 同時考慮貨艙體積與質量限制，辨認主導裝載瓶頸。
related.differenceEn: Evaluate volume and mass limits together and identify the limiting cargo constraint.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成帶中心反射率 0.16，兩側內插連續譜 0.20。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：D=1−0.16/0.20。 結果約 0.2 fraction。帶深 D=1−R帶/R連續譜；須先校正熱輻射與觀測幾何，連續譜不能為零。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成可用體積 20 m³、包裝密度 120 kg/m³、質量限制 3000 kg。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：體積限制質量=20×120=2400 kg，小於 3000 kg。 結果約 2400 kg。質量上限=min(允許質量,可用體積×包裝密度)；包裝密度不是材料密度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic band-center reflectance is 0.16 and interpolated continuum 0.20. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: D=1−0.16/0.20. Result ≈ 0.2 fraction. Band depth D=1−Rband/Rcontinuum requires thermal and geometric correction and a nonzero continuum.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic usable volume is 20 m³, packed density 120 kg/m³ and mass allowance 3000 kg. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Volume-limited mass=20×120=2400 kg, below 3000 kg. Result ≈ 2400 kg. Cargo limit=min(mass allowance, usable volume×packed density); packed density differs from material density.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
